description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-02 under fix/auto-carry-deferred-on-archive, which edited this skill's references/archival.md (the sweep now carries bare deferrals and asks the owner on owner blockers) and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the three verbs the description names — create, show, execute — plus archival and the German phrasing. Near-misses are the neighbours that share the word 'roadmap' and are someone else's job: authoring the content of a new roadmap (roadmap-writing), challenging one with the council (roadmap:ai-council), and turning a roadmap into tickets (emit-tickets). Counterexamples guard 'roadmap' as a product-strategy word and git branch management.

queries.q: show me the current roadmap and which phase we are in
execute the next phase of road-to-learning-you-can-see
this roadmap is at 100 percent — archive it
create a roadmap file for the settings migration with phases
zeig mir die offene Roadmap und archivier sie, wenn alles erledigt ist
write the phases, risk register and acceptance criteria for a new roadmap
queries.note: authoring the content of a roadmap, not managing the file's lifecycle → roadmap-writing

queries.q: challenge this roadmap with the AI council before we start
queries.note: a council review of the plan, not phase tracking → roadmap:ai-council

queries.q: turn the roadmap phases into Jira tickets
queries.note: ticket emission from a plan → emit-tickets

queries.q: what should our product roadmap look like for next year?
queries.note: 'roadmap' as product strategy, no roadmap file involved
git housekeeping that shares the 'archive / clean up' vocabulary
